items.title: Establish the migration contract and what stays frozen
items.context: Before touching anything, write the decision doc that answers: which identities move, which stay frozen and why, and how each moved identity handles pre-existing on-disk state. Must explicitly confirm and cite that lattice-*-integrity-v1 salts, and the 13 lattice-* agent role IDs, are NOT in scope. Must decide the read-both policy per item: a resolver that accepts the old path/name for reading while writing only the new one, versus a hard cutover with a one-time migration. Establishes the acceptance criterion that 326 story archives under .lattice/story/actives remain readable and their signatures still verify after migration.
items.userSees: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-identity-migration.md exists and states, per identity, RENAMED-with-migration or FROZEN plus the reason

items.title: Add a read-both path resolver for the state directory before moving any file
items.context: 193+ code sites reference the literal '.lattice'. Introduce a single resolver (extending the core/brand-env.ts additive pattern from B-cdf6) that resolves the state dir, adapter dir, and config filenames, accepting the deprecated name for READS and writing only the canonical name. Land this FIRST so the codebase can operate on either layout; that makes the actual move reversible instead of a flag day. Route every literal through the resolver.
items.userSees: a repo with .lattice present still works end to end, and grep for bare '.lattice' literals in packages/*/src returns only the resolver definition

items.title: Migrate the on-disk state directories with history preserved
items.context: git mv .lattice -> .proof-or-stop and .lattice-codex -> .proof-or-stop-codex, using git mv so history follows the files. 7571 tracked files. Verify afterward that story archives still parse, that signatures on historical findings/review-passes still verify (they must, since salts are path-independent), and that gitignore entries, lock paths and discovery files (.lattice-serve.json) were updated. This item is where the story either preserves 326 stories of evidence or destroys it.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop session_brief and story_get on an archived story both succeed against .proof-or-stop, and a historical finding signature still verifies

items.title: Rename the config and manifest filenames with a read-both fallback
items.context: lattice.config.json -> proof-or-stop.config.json (236+ source sites) and lattice.json -> proof-or-stop.json. Config discovery must accept the deprecated filename for reading so a teammate branch or an unmigrated project still loads, while init and writes emit only the canonical name. Include the .lattice-codex/lattice.json adapter manifest, which the adapter resolves by exact name.
items.userSees: a project containing only proof-or-stop.config.json loads correctly, and one containing only the old filename still loads with a deprecation notice

items.title: Rename the npm package to @proof-or-stop/core
items.context: 4 package.json manifests plus package-lock.json entries and 19 source import sites. This is a published-identity change, distinct in risk from the path renames: any external consumer resolving @lattice/core breaks. Update workspace references, rebuild, and confirm packages/utils (which imports packages/main build output) still resolves. Decide and record whether a deprecated alias package is warranted or whether this is a clean break.
items.userSees: npm --prefix packages/main run build succeeds and proof-or-stop --version prints the expected version with zero @lattice/core references outside frozen archives

items.title: Remove the deprecated bin aliases and prove nothing depends on them
items.context: Delete bin/lattice.js and bin/lattice-codex.js. Do this LAST, after the rest is green, because it is the one irreversible break of the multi-developer compatibility guarantee B-cdf6 established. bin/proof-or-stop-codex.js references the codex alias and verify_codex has a check for it; both need updating. Also update the package.json bin map, the pre-push hook's self-repo detection, and CLAUDE.md.
items.userSees: node bin/lattice.js fails with command-not-found while proof-or-stop --version and proof-or-stop codex verify both succeed

items.title: Extend the residue gate to enforce the new identities and re-pin affected fingerprints
items.context: The lattice-residue gate currently permits .lattice, lattice.config.json and @lattice/core as FROZEN rows. Flip those rows from exempt to forbidden in product runtime source so the migration cannot silently regress, keeping frozen-by-design tokens (salts, role IDs) exempt with recorded reasons. Also re-pin any canonical AST fingerprints the migration moves; note from B-cdf6 that one fingerprint had TWO coupled copies, so grep the old digest repo-wide before editing either.
items.userSees: node scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs passes and fails loudly if a bare .lattice or @lattice/core is reintroduced into packages/*/src
